style: Use the reference images only for STYLE: same illustrator, same grain texture, same palette and lighting language. Create a NEW scene: %s Editorial illustration in the style of Brian Stauffer and risograph prints: flat graphic shapes, rich grain gradients, cinematic composition, 16:9 film still for an animated documentary. Night palette of deep indigo and violet, cyan light for technology, warm amber light for people. Figures are small faceless silhouettes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

plates.p02: Seen from outside through one tall lit window of an old San Francisco apartment at night: a small faceless figure in an amber sweater sits at a wooden desk under a warm desk lamp, writing on a single sheet of paper. Dark facade around the window, cyan city glow reflected on the glass.
plates.p03: Night. A towering monolithic glass office building glowing cold cyan from inside, seen from the empty plaza below. A small faceless figure in an amber coat walks away from its bright entrance across the plaza toward the viewer, long shadow. Fog drifts. Huge scale contrast.
plates.p04: High view of a lone road crossing dark hills at night that splits into two roads at a fork. The left road leads into cold cyan fog and darkness; the right road leads toward a warm amber dawn glow on the horizon. A tiny faceless figure in an amber coat stands at the fork. Stars above.
plates.p05: Aerial view of San Francisco at night from high above: thousands of tiny windows, most glowing cyan, some warm amber, fog flowing between the hills, the Golden Gate Bridge small in the distance. Vast, calm, mysterious.
plates.p06: Inside a vast dark research hall at night: long rows of desks with glowing cyan monitors stretching far into the distance, cyan light reflected on the floor; only one desk is lit warmly by an amber lamp, where a single small faceless figure works. Deep perspective.
plates.p07: Wide panoramic view of a dark city skyline at night under a huge empty indigo sky with faint stars; low fog over the rooftops. The lower quarter is city, the upper three quarters are open dark sky. Minimal, calm.
plates.p08: Street level on a steep San Francisco street at night: a small faceless figure in an amber coat has stopped under a single street lamp in a pool of warm light, looking up thoughtfully. Fog, wooden Victorian houses, power lines, cyan city glow below.
plates.p09: A long airport runway at night seen low from its start: rows of amber runway edge lights converge toward the horizon in cyan fog. A passenger jet seen from behind waits at the start of the runway, its small red tail light glowing. Indigo sky.
plates.p10: Looking up from a rooftop into a vast night sky: the Milky Way as a long dim band of countless stars across the frame, dark silhouettes of chimneys and antennas along the bottom edge. Deep indigo and violet.
plates.p11: Early morning on a quiet San Francisco street: a small child with a big backpack walks toward a school gate holding the hand of a parent, both faceless silhouettes in warm amber light, long shadows, soft blue fog behind.
plates.p12: A dark glassblowing workshop: a small faceless figure in an amber apron shapes a glowing molten glass orb on a long pipe; the orb glows cyan-white and lights the room; the furnace mouth glows amber. Sparks, deep shadows.
plates.p14: A lonely two-lane road at night in thick fog: a small car with its headlights on, two beams cutting a short bright cone into the cyan fog ahead. A small faceless figure in an amber coat walks inside the lit patch in front of the car. Everything beyond the beams fades into fog.
plates.p15: A San Francisco street at night split vertically down the middle like a mirror: the left half bathed in cold cyan haze with dark empty windows, the right half with warm amber lit windows and a faint glow of dawn. A tiny faceless figure stands exactly on the dividing line in the street. Symmetric composition.
plates.p16: A dark quiet room at night: a large paper wall calendar lit by a warm amber desk lamp, a few pages lifting as if turning in a draft; a window behind with cyan city lights and fog.
plates.p17: A small faceless figure stands alone in a dark control room facing a giant circular screen that glows like a cyan eye with concentric rings. The figure's silhouette is lit amber by a small lamp. Huge scale contrast, stillness.
plates.p18: A calm laboratory at night with two people working at the back: on a bench in the foreground stands a closed glass terrarium with a thin hairline crack, a small cyan spark of light slipping out through the crack. Warm amber lamps, soft cyan glow. Calm, not alarming.
plates.p19: Close-up of a large old industrial lever switch on a control panel being pulled down by a hand in an amber sleeve; a small red indicator light glows steady beside it; cyan panel lights dim in the background.
plates.p20: An empty plaza at night filled with dense luminous cyan fog, a few faint street lamps, a tiny faceless figure in amber in the lower third looking into the fog. Large calm empty fog space in the upper half.
plates.p21: The Golden Gate Bridge at night seen through fog, the bridge drawn as glowing cyan line art over dark indigo, towers and cables outlined in light, a soft glow on the water. Quiet, mysterious.
plates.p22: Two small faceless figures in amber at a long table in a dark room with papers and a lamp, surrounded by nine small floating cyan lights like fireflies working above the table. Calm, curious mood.
plates.p23: A heavy door in a dark corridor stands half open; bright cyan light from a vast server hall spills through the gap onto the floor; a small faceless figure in an amber coat stands at the threshold. Strong light shaft.
plates.p24: Night sky over a dark mountain ridge in fog: a small airliner with blinking navigation lights flies safely high above the ridge; far below, a small airport with warm amber runway lights. Calm, vast.
plates.p25: Planet Earth seen from space, half in night, a thin glowing layer of atmosphere around it, a soft warm amber light healing over the southern pole; stars, deep indigo space. Graphic flat shapes.
plates.p26: Aerial view of a vast dark landscape covered by a grid of glowing computer chips laid out like city blocks, each chip a small square of cyan light, a few chips highlighted in amber, fog drifting, perspective to the horizon.
plates.p27: A San Francisco street at night: on the left sidewalk a small group of faceless figures holding lanterns, on the right sidewalk another small group with lanterns, facing each other across the street; their lights meet in the middle of the street. Fog, warm amber and cyan lights.
plates.p29: A hospital building at dawn on a San Francisco hill, warm amber windows, a soft protective cyan outline of light around the building like a shield, early morning fog glowing gold.
plates.p30: A wooden desk by a window at dawn: a single sheet of paper lies on it, golden morning light falls across it, plants on the sill, the city waking outside in soft gold and pale cyan.
plates.p31: A street of San Francisco Victorian houses at dawn: in many doorways and windows small faceless figures stand, each holding a small warm amber light; one figure walks on the street below. Golden mist, pale sky.
plates.p33: A vast golden dawn sky above the San Francisco skyline, clouds lit gold and pink, many small lights rising into the sky, some cyan and some amber, moving together like a flock of birds. Calm, hopeful, epic scale.

edits.p28: Edit this exact image: keep the same composition, the same street, buildings, lamp and figure, but change the time to early dawn: warm golden-pink sky, the fog glowing soft gold, the city light warm, gentle pale cyan shadows. Hopeful morning. Same grain illustration style. No text.
